title: Daily evidence digest — ops habit capture
content:
Quick morning capture (non-polished) — roll-forward list for SOC2 lane and vendor checks. Treat as single-author running log.

Top goals for today:
- [ ] Secure missing attestation from analytics vendor (Heap/Amplitude?) — reach out to procurement contact (TKT JIRA-SEC-1187).
- [ ] Pull last 90-day SSO logs (Okta) & package into evidence bundle for control AC-2 review. Command note: gcloud logging read "resource.type=global AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:okta" --limit=10000 > okta-90d.json (confirm with infra if sampling needed).
- [ ] Confirm retention policy doc updates applied to S3 buckets (policy PR linked). Verify lifecycle rules and encryption flag.
- [ ] Draft short rationale for exception request for legacy monitoring agent on one prod cluster — need to capture compensating controls.

Timeboxing (rough):
- 09:00–10:30 evidence pulls & packaging (Okta logs + S3 config)
- 10:45–11:30 vendor outreach email drafts + add to vendor matrix
- 13:00–14:00 policy text edits (access review cadence) + open PR
- 15:00 quick sync with Nora (#sec-compliance) — review outstanding pieces

Notes / gotchas:
- Heap vendor says they only provide quarterly SOC reports. Ask procurement for alternative attestation or ask vendor for endpoint-level logs export. Write two email options (ask for SOC; ask for export).
- Crashlytics shows up as a transitive dependency in mobile build; need proof of data flows. Jot: add mini-data-map and mark PII paths.
- Evidence filenames should follow: redwood-evidence/<control>-<yyyy-mm-dd>-<owner>.zip (tell SRE to keep perms locked).

Draft email snippets (quick):
- To vendor: "Hi — Diego from Redwood Inference. We're validating third-party controls for SOC2; could you share your latest attestation or an export of event logs for the past 90 days?"
- To infra: "Can you run the Okta export job for last 90 days and drop to gs://redwood-sec-evidence/tmp/okta-90d.json? Grant read to sec-audit-role."

Open questions / blockers:
- Who owns Crashlytics approvals — mobile eng or platform? (ping @mobile-eng lead in Slack).
- Do we accept vendor attestations older than 12 months for low-risk tools? Need product input.

To file/push tonight:
- Zip: redwood-evidence/AC-2-2026-03-13-diego.zip (Okta logs + S3 config export + notes).
- Create confluence summary with links to evidence and QC checklist (short checklist: filenames, checksums, perms, source extraction commands).

Quick checklist for evidence QC (rough):
- [ ] filename correct
- [ ] md5 checksum recorded
- [ ] owner recorded in manifest
- [ ] linked to JIRA ticket or confluence page
- [ ] storage ACL set to sec-audit-role only

Personal reminders:
- Stop multitasking in the 09:00 block — block calendar.
- If vendor doesn't respond in 48h, escalate to procurement (Nora).

End-of-day capture (to fill in later):
- items completed:
- items deferred and why:
- next actions for tomorrow:

-- Diego
